title: Audit event type registry
description: Validates metadata/audit/event-types/*.yaml. Seeded into audit_event_types, which audit_events.action_type references. An unregistered type fails at INSERT, and because a failed audit write fails the operation it records, it fails the request too.

gateway_derived.description: Gateway event types are derived from api-groups.v1.yaml rather than listed, so the registry cannot drift from the route policy.

verbs.description: Must match the verb map in backend/gateway/src/audit/middleware.ts.

overrides.description: Groups whose events outrank their audit level — break-glass and data rights.

sensitivity.description: Drives review priority and export redaction, not access control. 5 is identity disclosure, emergency access, or irreversible destruction.

retention.description: Matches the CHECK constraint on audit_event_types.retention.

id.description: Dotted, lower snake within each segment: domain.subject.verb. Immutable once published — existing audit rows reference it.

then.description: A sensitivity-5 event records identity disclosure, emergency access or irreversible destruction. Evidence of those must outlive whatever they touched, so it cannot be placed on an expiring retention cycle.
